messages:
marta: FYI - planned runtime patch tonight 01:00 UTC for kernel patch. Thinking we should pin Dedicated pools to model runtime v2.3.1 during the change window to avoid mismatches.

deploybot: Schedule set: deploybot will attempt rolling patch across eu-west-1 fam. Notifying relevant owners. Will pause autoscale for 15m during each shard.

ryan: @marta do we have customer-facing status copy? We should be explicit about potential short 1-2 min reconnections for active sessions.

sara-support: Draft statuspage snippet below — please review.

sara-support: ```
Component: Dedicated GPU pools (eu-west-1)
Status: Partial Maintenance
ETA: 01:00 - 03:00 UTC
Details: We will apply a routine runtime patch. Customers may see transient reconnects (under 2 minutes) for long-lived connections. No data loss expected.
If you have pinned to a specific runtime version, we recommend pinning to v2.3.1 until 04:00 UTC.
```

josh: Rollback criteria: if tail-latency > 2x baseline for >5 min or error rate >1% for 10m, initiate pause + roll-back plan. Ops-oncall to open incident bridge.

ops-oncall: noted. I'll be on-call for the window and will open the bridge at first sign of sustained errors. Tagging: @sara-support for customer comms, @ryan for release notes.

marta: Customer email snippet (short):

marta: "Hi — We'll perform a routine runtime patch on March 21, 01:00–03:00 UTC affecting Dedicated GPU pools in eu-west-1. You may experience brief reconnects (usually <2min). If you rely on an unpinned runtime, consider pinning to v2.3.1 before 01:00 UTC to maintain session stability."

ryan: LGTM. I'll paste to Statuspage and send to priority customers. :thumbsup:

sara-support: I'll queue the status page update and add a note to the top-of-hour monitoring checklist. Will also send the short email to the Priority 1 contact list once deploybot marks canary complete.

deploybot: Canary completed on shard-1 at 01:12 UTC. No regressions observed. Proceeding with staggered rollouts.

marta: Thanks all. If we hit the rollback triggers, we'll pin back to runtime v2.2.9 and run postmortem. Keep messages here for fast context. :rocket:
